description: Find Japan restaurants, inspect courses, and check a bounded shortlist before booking.

tools.name: source_calendar
tools.description: Read party-specific venue calendar; explicit slot booleans are venue-level and have no course linkage. Required: venue-id, start-at, party. Optional: locale (default: en). Returns the new CalendarResponse.

params.name: start-at
params.description: UTC ISO start anchor; actual coverage is response-driven

params.name: party
params.description: Exact party size for the venue calendar

tools.name: source_cuisines
tools.description: Cuisine stable filter keys and source translations. Returns the CuisinesResponse.

tools.name: source_menu-items
tools.description: Read course catalog for one venue and date window; listing status does not prove a bookable slot. Required: venue-id, from, to. Optional: locale (default: en), has-price (default: true), experiences. Returns the new MenusResponse.

params.name: from
params.description: Inclusive source menu window start as UTC ISO timestamp

params.name: to
params.description: Source menu window end as UTC ISO timestamp; boundary effect not independently isolated

params.name: experiences
params.description: Observed experience-page flag; an empty response does not rule out ordinary courses

tools.name: source_search
tools.description: Geographic venue discovery; budgets are venue dinner averages and availability is a discovery summary. Required: lat, lon, radius. Optional: universe-id (default: 57e0b91744aea12988000001), limit (default: 10), cursor (plus 13 more). Returns the SearchResponse.

params.name: limit
params.description: Requested results per page; focused commands cap at 50

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque meta.search_after cursor from the previous page

params.name: cuisine
params.description: Stable cuisine field from source cuisines; upstream wire key has array brackets

params.name: budget-min
params.description: Minimum venue dinner-average budget; source key observed but effect not independently isolated

params.name: budget-max
params.description: Maximum venue dinner-average budget; decimal text

params.name: time
params.description: Discovery meal-time preference HH:MM; does not filter to one exact slot

params.name: availability-mode
params.description: Use same_meal_time with date/time/party discovery inputs

params.name: availability-format
params.description: Use datetime with a specific discovery date

tools.name: source_venue
tools.description: Venue identity, source conditions and booking-page mode inside shops; caller geolocation is not venue location. Required: slug. Optional: locale (default: en). Returns the VenueResponse.

novel_features.name: Bounded trip scan
novel_features.description: Check a bounded restaurant shortlist across trip dates with partial results.

novel_features.name: Evidence status
novel_features.description: Report party-specific venue slots without upgrading search summaries or course listings into booking guarantees.

novel_features.name: Course cost and conditions
novel_features.description: Preserve exact prices, Japanese names, fine print and unknown charges.

novel_features.name: Visible freshness
novel_features.description: Keep cache age attached to every availability observation and refresh explicitly.

novel_features.name: Canonical handoff
novel_features.description: Return the correct TableCheck booking page with validated date, time and party.
